verdict.rationale: Stable offers building blocks that could surface government and legal mail. These include keyword-based auto-routing on envelope and contents, an AI inbox that sorts and routes mail, tags, AI summaries, and Slack/email alerts. Its registered agent product promises instant digital access to state and legal mail with automated routing. However, nothing shows built-in classification or prioritization of IRS, state, or service-of-process mail, so the operator would likely have to set up keyword rules and alerts themselves. Missing for 10: built-in government/legal mail detection or priority flagging, deadline extraction or tracking, escalation for unread compliance mail, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
